answer.headline: Conversion rate dropped within normal variation overall, but a severe product breakage hit the apparel landing page.
explanation: Although the overall weekly change stayed within normal historical variation, site-wide conversion fell from [F18] to [F19] due to weakness across several funnel steps.
A major candidate cause appeared on the apparel landing page section, where the product-view rate crashed by [F23] starting on [F30].
This localized drop disproportionately hurt conversion for visitors arriving on that section compared to the rest of the site.
answer.next_step: Investigate recent deployments and tag configurations affecting the apparel landing page and product catalog.
